book.witchery.guidebook.name: Guidebook
brazier.brazier.recipe: The Necromantic Stone at its heart is made in a [rite at night](entry://ritual/necro_stone).
brewing.cauldron_fermenting.page.1: A lit Cauldron turns out kitchen staples in moments. Clotted cream, fresh chocolate and a few teas need nothing more than the right ingredients and some altar power. Wine and beer are different. They want a Titration Barrel and time.
brewing.cauldron_fermenting.page.2: A young beer, rum or jade wine can still be rushed in the Cauldron when a recipe calls for one. It comes out weak, and the barrel does it better. Colorful World lists the rest of what the Cauldron can make.
brewing.infuse_seer.page.2: Needs 2000 altar power. Perform it at night.
brewing.infuse_seer.page.3: A Seer Stone can also be drawn from a pearl, sea glass and banshee powder.
brewing.potion_capacity.pentacle: Placed on the Altar, a Silver Pentacle also counts as a special modifier.
brewing.potion_pendants.page.1: A Fanciful Pendant steeped in the Cauldron becomes an empty Potion Pendant. Worn, a filled pendant gives its effect for as long as you carry Ink.
brewing.potion_pendants.page.2: Place the pendant inside a ritual circle with the ingredient for the effect and start the rite. A Lesser pendant takes a Whiff of Magic and holds one effect. A Greater pendant takes a Breath of the Goddess and holds a set: Explorer, Miner, Wanderer or Warrior.
brewing.potion_pendants.page.3: Lesser effects follow the usual brewing ingredients: Sugar for Speed, Blaze Powder for Strength, Magma Cream for Fire Resistance, and so on.
general.altar.candelabra: A Candelabra is a far stronger light for the Altar than candles or torches. Each colour of candle holder makes a candelabra of the same colour.
general.arthana.page.1: A ritual blade used in witchcraft. Place it on an Altar for ritual use; its strikes can also draw Ectoplasm from slain undead.
general.attunement.eternal_catalyst: An Eternal Catalyst calls Mog and Gulg to a Hobgoblin Patron at once.
general.attunement.eternal_catalyst_2: An Eternal Catalyst can be stretched into two.
general.attunement.page.1: Witchcraft leans on gems tuned to hold a charge. On a basic Pedestal, a Whiff of Magic over a bucket of lava and five powder of a single colour makes an attuned gem.
general.attunement.page.2: Attuned Topaz goes into the Distillery and Attuned Citrine into candelabras. Attuned Amethyst is used for the Tarot Deck, the Bloodstone Pendant and many rites. Attuned Onyx makes the Necromantic Stone, and Attuned Moonstone the Altar of the Moon and the Eternal Catalyst.
general.attunement.page.3: Attuned Onyx and Attuned Moonstone need the Onyx Pedestal. Moonstone takes three of each basic powder over a Breath of the Goddess instead of lava.
general.distillery.recipe: The Attuned Topaz at its base comes from a Pedestal. See [Attunement](entry://general/attunement).
general.hobgoblin.dust.page.1: They are found around their homes. Will mine for Silver Dust if equipped with a pickaxe and food, any stone or dust will be deposited in a chest nearby the mine, or shift right clicked on them.
general.oven.page.2: Saplings from far places give their own vapours. Acacia, Pale Oak and the strange saplings of the caves, the dread forests and Limbo give a Reek of Misfortune. Coloured saplings give a Whiff of Magic, a Peach Sapling a Breath of the Goddess and a Duplicator Sapling an Exhale of the Horned One.
general.oven.page.3: The Oven also bakes a few things that are not saplings, and still catches a vapour from each.
general.owl.page.1:
Familiar, quite stupid but grants better control over broom when bound.

general.parasitic_louse.page.1:
Can be picked up, has the ability to store and apply a Potion. Use potion on louse to apply it. has a chance to consume the potion on attacking a creature.

general.spinning_wheel.page.2: The wheel spins more than witch thread. Pure Darkness, Dark Tatters and Moth Dust make Shadow Silk. Wool and World Thread make coloured Fabric, and World Thread and Stable Fabric are woven into armour and other goods of Limbo. Wool or Truffalo tufts give costume Cloth, and Vibranium with string gives Vibranium Weave.

ritual.bind_spectral_creatures.page.1: Binds spectral creatures like Spectres, Gravewailers and Poltergeists to an Effigy, like a Scarecrow, Trent Effigy or Witch's Ladder.
ritual.bind_spectral_creatures.page.2: Needs 6000 altar power. Perform it at night.
ritual.bind_spectral_creatures.scarecrow: A Scarecrow is the simplest effigy to make.
ritual.charge_attuned.page.1: Charges an Attuned Amethyst, this charge is required by some recipes and rituals, can also replace Altar Power up to 3000.

ritual.curse_of_overheating.page.2: Needs 2000 altar power. Perform it during a storm.
ritual.curse_of_sinking.page.2: Needs 2000 altar power. Perform it during a storm.
ritual.curse_of_the_wolf.page.2: Needs 10000 altar power. Perform it under a full moon. Needs 6 witches from your coven.

ritual.hunger.page.2: Needs 2500 altar power. Perform it during a storm.
ritual.necro_stone.page.1: Perform this rite at night to create a Necromatic Stone from Attuned Onyx, bone, rotten flesh, Wood Ash, and Ectoplasm. It is used in rites concerning spectral creatures and manifestation.
ritual.necro_stone.page.2: Needs 1000 altar power. Perform it at night.
ritual.pet_rituals.page.1: A Poppet, a few things the creature likes and a living creature of the same kind to sacrifice make a pet you can carry. Some are bound by day, others by night.
ritual.pet_rituals.page.2: Idols are carved in a plain circle from Stardust, Vegetal, a Radium Shard and the creature's head.
ritual.raining_toad.page.2: Needs no altar power. Needs one witch from your coven.
ritual.remembrance.page.1: A creature's head, the thing it loved best and a lump of Vegetal, set in an infernal circle, bring the creature back. Almost every creature has its own rite.
ritual.remembrance.page.2: The greatest creatures ask for more power and a little Ectoplasm.
ritual.remembrance.page.3: Creatures from farther afield can be remembered too. Where there is no head to offer, a skull or something the creature drops takes its place. The big ones, and any whose trophy is hard to come by, only answer a witch who has already killed one. Until then the circle hands the offerings back.
ritual.remove_curse.page.2: Needs 2000 altar power. Perform it by day.
ritual.rite_of_bloodbinding.page.1: Binds blood into a Bloodstone Pendant. Once empowered, the pendant drinks even faster than before.
ritual.rite_of_bloodbinding.page.2: Requires a normal Bloodstone Pendant, a Drop of Luck, Demon's Blood, a Bottle of Blood, a Necromantic Stone, and a Nether Star.
Marks the centre of every ritual circle.
ritual.ritual.ritual_chalk.infernal_chal: Draws the circles used for demonic rites.
ritual.ritual.ritual_chalk.otherwhere_ch: Draws the circles used for travel and the spirit.
ritual.rot.page.2: Needs 6000 altar power. Perform it under a waning or new moon.
ritual.summon_beasts.page.1: Three larger circles call up beasts that are hard to find. Each rite is cast at night. The Hydra and the Gorgon answer a plain circle, the Kraken only an Otherwhere one.
ritual.summon_spectral_pig.page.1: Summons a Spectral Pig which will drop Ectoplasm, a valuable resource
ritual.venom.page.1: Concealing Oils, a Malachite Glass Ampoule or a Nightfall's Blade can be steeped in a ritual circle with a Whiff of Magic and one ingredient. Add Glowstone Dust for level II or a Midnight Chip for level III, though the effect gets shorter: 30 seconds, then 20, then 10. Ampoules only take level I. Steeping an item again swaps its effect and keeps its enchantments, damage and name.
ritual.venom.page.2: Spider Eye gives Poison, Bone Ash Deadly Poison, Downstone Fragments Life Drain, Fermented Spider Eye Weakness and Wither Rose Wither. Citrine Shard gives Hunger, Antimetal Levitation, Amethyst Shard Mining Fatigue, Sugar Slowness, Onyx Shard Somnolence and a Four-Leaved Clover Bad Luck.
ritual.venom.page.3: Jadeite Petals give Eternal Slumber and Moonstone Powder Fatal Slumber, up to level II. These stay at level I: Dragonbone Chunk for Scarred, Echo Shard for Darkness, Tiger's Eye for Glowing, Stone for Infested, Slime Block for Oozing, Cobweb for Weaving and Breeze Rod for Wind Charged. Each use drains Ink of the effect's color.
spirit_world.hunger.page.1: Kill your Dreamstalker to get it. It can be carried between dream and reality.
spirit_world.manifestation.page.2: Requires Ectoplasm, Mellifluous Hunger, a Necromatic Stone, an Arthana, and a Breeze Rod. The rite needs 5000 altar power and a Small Otherwhere ritual circle.
spirit_world.nightmare.page.1: In the Nightmare world, a personal Dreamstalker hunts each dreamer. It appears nearby and returns after a time unless defeated. Slay it to claim Mellifluous Hunger and earn a brief respite from its pursuit.
tarot.tarot_reading.recipe: The Attuned Amethyst comes from a Pedestal. See [Attunement](entry://general/attunement).
vampirism.bloodstone_pendant.page.1: Wear this pendant in a Curio slot. It greatly increases a vampire's blood-drinking speed while worn.
vampirism.vampirism.batwing_pendant.titl: Only useful to a vampire who can take bat form.
witchery.bloodstone_pendant.empowered: Bound in blood. Increases blood-drinking speed even further.

witchery:ritual/infuse_seer_pearl.toolti: Draws a Seer Stone from a pearl

ritual.viltrumites.page.1:
An Otherwhere circle can send a signal far past the sky, and Viltrum answers. Lucan, Vidor and Thula land half a minute later and fight until they or you are dead. Each drops a vial of their blood.

Conquest comes only at night, to a circle of two chalks. The Bounty sends the squad after whoever is bound to the Taglock. Cast outside the Overworld, nothing hears you.
